GatedDeltaNetAttention is a PluggableLayer. Ascend already registers a replacement and its worker patch assigns Qwen GDN forward/_forward_core. Registration order, actual instance class and duplicate-registry rules must be verified; do not overwrite registries or copy whole forward.
Does not expose the unpack-plus-norm combination inside qwen_gdn_attention_core. Existing Triton kernel need not be rewritten as aclnn just to register it.
